title: Mechanical Dissociation of Tissues for Single Cell Analysis Using a Motorized Device
protocol: Remove dissected tissue and place it in cold cell culture media with 5% fetal bovine serum (FBS).
Chop the tissue using sharp dissection scissors until fragments are smaller than 1 mm in any dimension.
Transfer minced tissue to a 15 mL conical tube and add 5 ml of media.
Add digestion enzymes based on the tissue and cell types being isolated.
Incubate on a shaker or rocker for 1 h at 37 °C with gentle agitation throughout the incubation.
Pipette the sample up and down 100 times.
Add EDTA to achieve a sample volume with a 5 mM concentration.
Pipette the sample up and down 100 times, then vigorously pipette the sample up and down 100 times.
Pass the sample through a 70 µm cell strainer and collect it in a 50 mL or 15 mL tube.
Centrifuge the collected cells at 300 x g for 5 min at 4 °C.
Remove the supernatant using a pipette and resuspend cells in 1 ml of red blood cell lysis buffer.
Incubate for 1 min at room temperature.
Neutralize the lysis buffer by adding 9 ml of cold 1X Phosphate Buffered Saline (PBS).
Centrifuge collected cells at 300 x g for 5 min at 4 °C.
Remove supernatant using a pipette.
Resuspend cells in desired buffer or media.
Place dissected tissue in cold cell culture media with 5% fetal bovine serum (FBS).
Chop tissue using sharp dissection scissors until fragments are approximately 5 mm in any dimension.
Transfer chopped tissue to C-tube and add 1 mL of media.
Load the C-tube onto the device.
Fit tube holder plate over D-shaped tube bottoms.
Secure tubes to motor plate by latching tension arms into acrylic plate.
Choose Custom Mode from Main Menu by pressing blue button.
In first custom mode menu, specify forward rotation duration to 30 s by pressing red button until value on screen reads 30 s.
Select this value and advance to next menu screen.
In second custom mode menu, specify reverse rotation duration to 10 s by pressing red button until value on screen reads 10 s.
Select this value and advance to next menu screen.
Specify the number of repetitions in the custom mode menu by pressing the red button until the value reads 4X.
Press the blue button to confirm and start the program.
Adjust the voltage control dial until the LCD screen displays 200 rpm.
Add Collagenase 4 (1 mg/mL), Collagenase D (1 mg/mL), and DNase (40 µg/mL) in 4 mL media.
Load the C-tube onto the device.
Run the program at 200 rpm: Forward, 30 s; Reverse, 10 s; Loop, 4 times.
Transfer the device with loaded tubes to a 37 °C incubator for 45 min.
Repeat steps 2.3-2.6 and run the following program at 50 rpm: Forward, 270 s; Reverse, 30 s; Loop, 9 times.
Add EDTA to achieve a concentration of 5 mM in the sample.
Load the C-tube onto the device again.
Run the final program at 100 rpm: Forward, 30 s; Reverse, 10 s; Loop, 2 times.
Push the sample through a 70 µm cell strainer and collect it in a 50 mL or 15 mL tube.
Centrifuge the collected cells at 300 x g for 5 min at 4 °C.
Discard the supernatant using a pipette.
Resuspend cells in 1 mL of red blood cell lysis buffer.
Incubate for 1 min at room temperature.
Neutralize the lysis buffer with 9 mL of cold Phosphate Buffered Saline (PBS).
Centrifuge the collected cells again at 300 x g for 5 min at 4 °C.
Discard the supernatant using a pipette.
Resuspend cells in the desired buffer or media.
